questions.question: --------- is a process where the precipitate is re-dissolved and precipitated out of a cleaner environment.

explanations.a: Dissociation is not the correct process here.
explanations.b: Digestion is related but not the process of re-dissolution and re-precipitation.
explanations.d: Correct: Crystallization involves re-dissolving and precipitating in a cleaner environment.

questions.question: Digestion can help reduce the amount of-------------

explanations.a: Digestion does not reduce precipitation itself.
explanations.b: Incorrect: Post-precipitation is not significantly affected by digestion.
explanations.c: Correct: Digestion reduces co-precipitation by allowing impurities to separate.
explanations.d: Nucleation is the initial step and not reduced by digestion.

questions.question: The mass of substance is measured as a function of temperature in-----------

explanations.a: Not related to temperature-based mass measurement.
explanations.d: Correct: Thermogravimetry measures mass changes as temperature varies.
